component-o.description-s: USB Type-C 2.0 receptacle, 16 contacts, through-hole, right angle, 5 A / 48 VDC, 20000 cycles; board power input (VBUS/GND, CC1/CC2 with 5.1k Rd pull-downs for a sink, D+/D- brought out)

connector-o.contact_height_source-s: GCT USB4085 drawing Rev B p1: contact resistance 40 mOhm max initial (50 after test); height 3.46 mm read from the side view (shell alone 3.16)
connector-o.shell_tht_source_s: four plated through-hole shell tabs (footprint pads SH, thru_hole oval; GCT USB4085 drawing: through-hole shell legs)
connector-o.board_area_note_s: courtyard (right-angle at the board edge: the mate overhangs the edge)
connector-o.fields_source_s: 5 A / 20 V for the receptacle = 1.25 A on each of the 4 VBUS / 4 GND contacts; signal contacts 0.25 A (Nexar maker spec)

stdpins-ao.A8: SBU1, unused for a power sink

stdpins-ao.B8: SBU2, unused for a power sink

stdpins-ao.SH: shield, tie to chassis/ground at the connector

stdpins-ao.A5c: CC1/CC2: USB-C sink must present Rd = 5.1k to GND on each CC pin or a Type-C source keeps VBUS off; the 5.1k-avss shorthands place them

provenance-o.basis-s: procurement public-check: every document in the record folder has a public http(s) source; nothing confidential, no correspondence or quote data, no person named outside non-technical-o, not an NDA part; footprint and 3D model of recorded public origin
